name: Na kryshe
source:
The story of a teenager who faces various difficulties trying to understand how this treacherous life is arranged. Why do people do certain things? What is the value of life? Should we discuss these issues with a mysterious friend on the empty roof of a multi-storey building?

[From [url=https://prettytea.itch.io/ontheroof]itch.io[/url]]
